_comment_emergent_preset: Emergent behaviour preset, loaded from configs/emergent/<name>.json and overlaid on this file. Options: default, cells, swarm, orbits, gas, chains. Each preset sets num_clusters, g_attract, g_repel and pair_rules. Set to null to instead use any g_attract/g_repel/pair_rules/num_clusters listed in THIS file (or built-in defaults). NOTE: attraction_enabled must be true to see the effect.
_comment_toggles: Preconfigure simulation toggles. Both default to true if omitted.
_comment_max_rounds: Stop the simulation after this many rounds (counts regardless of whether CFL is enabled). Set to null (or omit) to run indefinitely.
_comment_obstacles: Obstacle layout for reproducible runs. null/omitted = 4 random obstacles. Integer N = N random obstacles. List = exact layout, each entry [x, y, r] or {"x":.., "y":.., "r":..}. SIM area is 1000x800.
_comment_force_scale: Multiplies all g values (from the preset or this file) before passing to the simulator. force_scale=25 makes g=1.0 here equivalent to g=25 internally.
